Are there any joining fees?+

The joining fee for each plan is shown separately. The club confirms applicable taxes and final charges before you pay.

Is personal training included?+

Personal training is a separate service. Ask the team about available coaching, scheduling, and prices.

How does a trial work?+

Submit a trial request with your preferred date and time. The front desk will contact you to confirm availability and any trial fee.

What are the refund and freeze policies?+

Review the FAQs and policies page, and request the club’s confirmed written terms before purchasing.
